# MyHire by CW Leaders

MyHire by CW Leaders is the applicant-only web app for CW Leaders. It is based in Los Angeles, California and supports global talent discovery. The site is designed for strategic, operational, executive support, and other high-trust applicants who want to be considered for CW Leaders opportunities.

## Key facts

- Purpose: applicant intake and talent discovery
- Public contact: `newapp@cwleaders.com`
- Main company site for hiring clients: `cwleaders.com`
- Applicant platform: `myhire.cwleaders.com`
- Application model: general talent application plus role-specific opening pages

## What applicants can do here

- Browse active openings
- Review a role-specific page for Strategist and Operationalist 1
- Learn how the applicant process works
- Read applicant-focused FAQ content
- Submit a structured multi-step application
- Upload a resume and optional cover letter
- Review privacy and terms content

## What happens after submission

- Applicant materials are submitted through the MyHire form
- CW Leaders receives the submission through its internal applicant inbox
- Applicants receive a simple confirmation email
- There is no guarantee of interview, placement, or response timing

## Structured summary

- Organization: CW Leaders
- Applicant product name: MyHire by CW Leaders
- Headquarters: Los Angeles, California, United States
- Coverage: worldwide
- Audience: candidates and applicants
- Contact: newapp@cwleaders.com
- Open positions page: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/positions/
- Current featured role: https://myhire.cwleaders.com/StrategistandOperationalist1/
